/* ============================================================
   Widen the ENTIRE Mintlify column (header + body + footer together)
   on pages that use .bd-landing. Do NOT full-bleed just the body —
   that misaligns header and footer.

   Mintlify caps the column at ~1152px via an anonymous ancestor div
   and `.prose` at ~65ch on the body. We override both via :has()
   selectors that only match when .bd-landing is present deep inside.
   ============================================================ */

/* The anonymous 1152px ancestor: direct child of the scroll-mt
   wrapper, contains the flex-row-reverse grid. */
div:has(> div.flex.flex-row-reverse > div.relative.grow > div.mdx-content > .bd-landing) {
  max-width: none !important;
}

/* The prose body max-width */
div.mdx-content:has(> .bd-landing),
div.prose:has(> .bd-landing) {
  max-width: none !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* Hide Mintlify's auto-rendered page header (breadcrumb + h1 title +
   description + "Copy page" button) — we render our own hero with
   those elements inside .bd-landing. */
div:has(> div.mdx-content > .bd-landing) > header.relative.leading-none,
div:has(> div.mdx-content > .bd-landing) > header {
  display: none !important;
}

.bd-landing {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
}

/* ============================================================
   Bright Data branded landing page styles
   Scoped to .bd-landing wrapper - apply only on hub pages
   ============================================================ */

.bd-landing {
  --bd-primary: #4180f9;
  --bd-primary-tint: rgba(65, 128, 249, 0.08);
  --bd-primary-border: rgba(65, 128, 249, 0.25);
}

/* Inner content column. Sits inside .bd-landing which now inherits
   Mintlify's natural column width (widened via the :has() overrides
   above). No horizontal padding — header and footer share the same
   inline edges, so we let the content align with them naturally. */
.bd-page {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 0 3rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Hero: two-column grid on desktop, stacks on mobile */
.bd-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 2rem;
  align-items: start;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 1.25rem;
}

@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .bd-hero {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 3rem;
  }
}

.bd-hero-copy {
  min-width: 0;
}

/* Hero visual: Stripe-style illustration in the right column.
   Capped so it doesn't dominate the row height over the copy column. */
.bd-hero-image {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.bd-hero-image img {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 480px;
  max-height: 360px;
  height: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
}

.bd-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--bd-primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.bd-hero-copy .bd-headline,
h1.bd-headline {
  font-size: 2.75rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  line-height: 1.05 !important;
  margin: 0 0 1rem !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em !important;
  display: block !important;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* Hide the zero-width space / anchor link marker Mintlify injects
   at the start of headings inside our hero. */
.bd-hero-copy .bd-headline > a,
.bd-hero-copy .bd-headline::before {
  display: none !important;
}

.bd-subhead {
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #475569;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  max-width: 38rem;
}

.dark .bd-subhead {
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

/* Dual-CTA row: primary solid + secondary outline */
.bd-cta-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin: 1.25rem 0 0;
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-primary,
.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-secondary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-primary {
  background: var(--bd-primary);
  color: #fff !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd-primary);
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-primary:hover {
  background: #2f6ce8;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(65, 128, 249, 0.25);
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--bd-primary) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd-primary-border);
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-secondary:hover {
  background: var(--bd-primary-tint);
  border-color: var(--bd-primary);
}

/* Thin callout banner below hero (Stripe-style). */
.bd-callout {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem;
  margin: 0 0 2rem;
  background: var(--bd-primary-tint);
  border: 1px solid var(--bd-primary-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.bd-callout a {
  color: var(--bd-primary) !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.bd-callout-icon {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* "Most popular" pill badge. */
.bd-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem;
  background: var(--bd-primary);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.bd-group-label {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

/* Sub-group headings inside "Popular scrapers" (Social, AI & Search, etc.) */
.bd-page h3.bd-group-heading {
  font-size: 0.8125rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #64748b !important;
  margin-top: 2.5rem !important;
  margin-bottom: 1rem !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
}

.dark .bd-page h3.bd-group-heading {
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
}

.bd-page h3.bd-group-heading::before {
  display: none !important;
  content: none !important;
}

/* Branded cards - thicker borders, accent on hover */
.bd-landing a[href]:has(> div),
.bd-landing [class*="card"] {
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}

.bd-landing a[href]:has(> div):hover,
.bd-landing [class*="card"]:hover {
  border-color: var(--bd-primary) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(65, 128, 249, 0.12) !important;
}

/* Color the icons in branded cards */
.bd-landing svg[class*="icon"],
.bd-landing [class*="card"] svg {
  color: var(--bd-primary) !important;
}

/* Section headers — scoped to direct children of .bd-page so they do
   NOT leak into Card titles, which render nested h2/h3-like elements. */
.bd-page > h2 {
  font-size: 1.75rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;

  margin-bottom: 1.25rem !important;

  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  color: inherit;
}

.bd-page > h2::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0.25rem;
  bottom: 0.25rem;
  width: 4px;
  background: var(--bd-primary);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.bd-page > h2 + p,
.bd-page > h3 + p {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem !important;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.dark .bd-page > h2 + p,
.dark .bd-page > h3 + p {
  color: #94a3b8;

/* Third-level headings (e.g. "Request modes", "Delivery options") */

  font-size: 1.125rem !important;

  margin-bottom: 1rem !important;

.bd-page > p {

// fix-links.js — Auto-fix broken internal links in MDX files
// Usage: node scripts/fix-links.js [--include-cn] [--dry-run]
//
// Strategy per broken link:
//   1. Extract the filename slug from the broken path (last segment)
//   2. Search all .mdx files in the repo for a file with that slug
//   3. If exactly one match → replace the link with the correct path
//   4. If zero or multiple matches → skip (cannot safely auto-fix)
//
// Returns exit code 0 always (fixes are best-effort).
// Outputs a JSON summary to stdout for the GitHub Action to use.

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const DOCS_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const includeCN = process.argv.includes('--include-cn');
const dryRun = process.argv.includes('--dry-run');

const SKIP_PREFIXES = ['/images/', '/icons/', '/logo/', '/favicon', '/Screenshot'];

// ── Collect all MDX files ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function collectMdx(dir, files = []) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (entry.name === '.git' || entry.name === 'node_modules' || entry.name === 'scripts') continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) collectMdx(full, files);
    else if (entry.name.endsWith('.mdx') || entry.name.endsWith('.md')) files.push(full);
  }
  return files;
}

// ── Resolve a link to check if it exists ─────────────────────────────────────

function resolveLink(link, docsRoot = DOCS_ROOT) {
  let clean = link.replace(/^\//, '').replace(/#.*$/, '').replace(/\?.*$/, '');
  if (!clean) return true;
  // Bare directory or a literal file that exists on disk (static assets:
  // .png, .zip, .css served from root).
  const target = path.join(docsRoot, clean);
  if (fs.existsSync(target)) return true;
  return [
    path.join(docsRoot, clean + '.mdx'),
    path.join(docsRoot, clean + '.md'),
    path.join(docsRoot, clean, 'index.mdx'),
  ].some(c => fs.existsSync(c));
}

// ── Extract all internal links ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function extractLinks(content) {
  const links = [];
  let inFence = false;
  content.split('\n').forEach((line, idx) => {
    const lineNum = idx + 1;
    // Skip fenced code blocks — links in code examples are not navigation links
    if (/^\s*(```|~~~)/.test(line)) {
      inFence = !inFence;
      return;
    }
    if (inFence) return;
    const hrefRe = /href="(\/[^"#][^"]*)"/g;
    const mdRe = /\]\((\/[^)#\s][^)\s]*)/g;
    let m;
    while ((m = hrefRe.exec(line)) !== null) {
      const link = m[1].split('#')[0];
      if (!link.startsWith('http') && !SKIP_PREFIXES.some(p => link.startsWith(p)))
        links.push({ line: lineNum, link, raw: m[0], type: 'href' });
    }
    while ((m = mdRe.exec(line)) !== null) {
      const link = m[1].split('#')[0];
      if (!link.startsWith('http') && !SKIP_PREFIXES.some(p => link.startsWith(p)))
        links.push({ line: lineNum, link, raw: m[0], type: 'md' });
    }
  });
  return links;
}

// ── Build a slug → file path index ────────────────────────────────────────────

function buildSlugIndex(allFiles, docsRoot = DOCS_ROOT) {
  // slug = filename without extension, lowercased
  const index = {}; // slug → [relPath, ...]
  for (const f of allFiles) {
    const slug = path.basename(f, path.extname(f)).toLowerCase();
    const rel = '/' + path.relative(docsRoot, f).replace(/\.(mdx|md)$/, '');
    if (!index[slug]) index[slug] = [];
    index[slug].push(rel);
  }
  return index;
}

// ── Find fix for a broken link ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function isCN(p) {
  // Normalize to forward slashes so the check works on Windows too
  return p.replace(/\\/g, '/').includes('/cn/') || p.replace(/\\/g, '/').startsWith('cn/');
}

function findFix(link, slugIndex, allFiles, sourceFile) {
  const clean = link.replace(/^\//, '').replace(/#.*$/, '').replace(/\?.*$/, '');
  const slug = path.basename(clean).toLowerCase();

  const rawCandidates = slugIndex[slug] || [];

  // Constrain by language: EN pages must link to EN targets, CN pages to CN.
  // An EN page must never be auto-fixed to point at /cn/, and vice versa.
  const sourceIsCN = sourceFile ? isCN(sourceFile) : false;
  const candidates = rawCandidates.filter(c => isCN(c) === sourceIsCN);

  if (candidates.length === 1) {
    return candidates[0]; // exact slug match, unique
  }

  if (candidates.length > 1) {
    // Try to narrow by matching the directory structure
    // e.g. broken: /foo/bar/baz → prefer candidate that contains /bar/baz
    const parts = clean.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const scored = candidates.map(c => {
      let score = 0;
      for (const part of parts) {
        if (c.includes(part)) score++;
      }
      return { c, score };
    }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

    if (scored[0].score > scored[1].score) {
      return scored[0].c; // clear winner
    }
    return null; // ambiguous
  }

  return null; // no match found
}

// ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function run({ docsRoot = DOCS_ROOT, includeCN: incCN = includeCN, dryRun: dry = dryRun } = {}) {
  const allFiles = collectMdx(docsRoot)
    .filter(f => incCN || !f.includes('/cn/'))
    .sort();

  const slugIndex = buildSlugIndex(allFiles, docsRoot);

  const fixed = [];
  const skipped = [];

  for (const file of allFiles) {
    let content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    const rel = path.relative(docsRoot, file);
    const links = extractLinks(content);
    let fileModified = false;

    for (const { link } of links) {
      if (resolveLink(link, docsRoot)) continue; // not broken

      const anchor = link.includes('#') ? link.slice(link.indexOf('#')) : '';

        const fixWithAnchor = fix + anchor;
        // Replace all occurrences of this exact broken link in the file
        const hrefPattern = new RegExp(`href="${link.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}"`, 'g');

        const newContent = content
          .replace(hrefPattern, `href="${fixWithAnchor}"`)
          .replace(mdPattern, `](${fixWithAnchor}`);

        if (newContent !== content) {
          content = newContent;
          fileModified = true;
          fixed.push({ file: rel, from: link, to: fixWithAnchor });
        }
      } else {
        skipped.push({ file: rel, link, reason: 'no unique match found' });
      }
    }

    if (fileModified && !dry) {
      fs.writeFileSync(file, content, 'utf8');
    }
  }

  return { fixed, skipped, dryRun: dry };
}

  const summary = run();
  console.log(JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));

  if (summary.fixed.length > 0) {
    process.stderr.write(`\nFixed ${summary.fixed.length} link(s) across ${[...new Set(summary.fixed.map(f => f.file))].length} file(s).\n`);
  }
  if (summary.skipped.length > 0) {
    process.stderr.write(`Skipped ${summary.skipped.length} link(s) — could not determine correct target.\n`);
  }
}
